question: Who is the richest woman in the world in 2025, according to the Forbes Billionaire List?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alice Walton**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Alice Walton (Walmart) is the world's richest woman** in 2025, with a **net worth of $112.5 billion**, surpassing **Francoise Bettencourt Meyers (L’Oréal, $74.4 billion)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India’s richest woman, Savitri Jindal & family**, ranks **7th globally** with a **net worth of $32.3 billion**, leading **JSW Group**.
 
• **Marilyn Simons (Hedge Funds)** is the **new entrant** in the top 10, ranking **10th with $31.0 billion**.
 
• **Other top billionaires include Julia Koch ($74.2B), Jacqueline Mars ($42.3B), Rafaela Aponte-Diamant ($39.0B), Abigail Johnson ($36.0B), MacKenzie Scott ($32.3B), and Miriam Adelson ($31.5B)**.
 
• **The top 10 women collectively hold over $500 billion in wealth**, leading industries from retail and beauty to finance and shipping.
